fields.value: Title : Development of a Unified Framework for the Recognition of Printed and Handwritten Manipuri Script using OCR and Deep Learning Techniques. Conducting research on a unified framework for recognition of printed and handwritten Manipuri script using OCR and deep learning techniques. Developed image preprocessing, dataset preparation, and augmentation workflows for handwritten character recognition. Implemented transfer learning using PyTorch and evaluated AlexNet, ResNet-50, MobileNetV3, and EfficientNetV2. Research areas include computer vision, OCR, image classification, deep learning, transfer learning, and pattern recognition.
